changeRequest.title: Add findUser lookup
changeRequest.body:
## What
Adds `findUser` for the session middleware.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `findUser` resolves to `null` for an unknown id and never throws: the session middleware treats `null` as signed out, and an exception there returns 500 to every logged-out visitor.

## Evidence
`pnpm check` passes.

expectedFindings.label: throws for an unknown id though the acceptance criteria require null
